content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://daic.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 29-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Financial Adviser post at DAIC?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Financial Adviser post at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre is 29th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Financial Adviser position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in any subject from a recognized university, along with 15 years of administrative, academic, or managerial experience. Experience in accounts or financial advice is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Financial Adviser recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Financial Adviser post is 56 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Financial Adviser post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Financial Adviser post at the Dr. Ambedkar International Centre.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Financial Adviser role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Financial Adviser post will receive a salary in Pay Band 4, ranging from Rs. 37400 to Rs. 67000 per month, with a Grade Pay of Rs. 8700 (Level-13 in 7th CPC).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the DAIC Financial Adviser recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Financial Adviser post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Screening and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, which is https://daic.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation.
